title: Titanium Threaded NPT Nipple
system: Chemical Pipe Fittings & Flow Control Components
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this pipe fitting application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by npt threaded pipe nipple and fat life requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding Grade 2 with 0.5mm corner radius
Hydrostatic shell test with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming
commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Threaded NPT Nipple suitable for NPT threaded pipe nipple?
faq.a: Titanium Threaded NPT Nipple uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pipe fitting operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Threaded NPT Nipple?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Threaded NPT Nipple require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. pipe fitting components receive Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Threaded NPT Nipple shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Nipple / Threaded pipe pipe fitting components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
